title: Fideon canonical schema - directors_officers (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for directors and officers liability (L1 code directors_officers), composing common_model.json 1.1.0 by $ref: the envelope plus the claims_made_terms and insuring_agreements blocks. Built from the single-LOB D&O declarations of the source-data do folder (read in place): Wesco's private company D&O coverage element (filed under AmTrust), Zurich's Select Plus private company declarations (ARC Excess & Surplus), Federal's personal director's liability declarations (Chubb), Hudson Excess' Private Defender declarations (CNA Companies), Philadelphia Indemnity's FlexiPlus Five declarations and United States Liability's community association D&O declarations (RT Specialty). Every field of the pre-SPEC_21 directors_officers.json (directors_officers.crosswalk.yaml). No LOB block. 2.1.0 adds the coverage parts of CNA's Investment Management Liability Solutions declarations (Columbia Casualty, filed under ARC Excess & Surplus).
fideon:status: SPEC_21 Phase 2 schema (12 October 2026), built from the do folder's single-LOB declarations; replaces the pre-SPEC_21 directors_officers.json 1.5.0. Draft for the project owner's approval; the seed golds drafted against it are DRAFT, pending reviewer sign-off. 2.1.0 (14 October 2026): three coverage-part codes and two aliases for CNA's Investment Management Liability Solutions declarations.

corpora: synth_core/fideon/synth_core/data/source data/<Carrier>/do/ (9 documents; 8 seeds, 1 broker proposal)
synth_core/fideon/synth_core/data/source data/ARC Excess & Surplus, LLC/epli/ (1 document: CNA Investment Management Liability Solutions declarations, read with this schema)

fideon:lob_block: None. Each coverage part, element or insuring clause the declarations schedule is a coverage (its limit, sub-limit, retention, premium); the policy aggregate is the DO_POLICY_AGGREGATE coverage; the pending or prior, continuity and retroactive dates and the extended reporting (discovery) period are claims_made_terms; retentions printed by claim type rather than by insuring clause, scheduled organizations and notice addresses are additional_fields (SPEC_21 4.2.4).
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-5 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules, the claims-made rule kept: every D&O declarations of the seeds is claims made. A rule whose values a document does not print is not evaluated.
